question: The average gini recalculated of the world in 2015
query: SELECT AVG(gini_recalculated) FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015;
answer: The recalculated average Gini coefficient for the world in 2015 is approximately 0.39. This indicates a moderate level of income inequality. The Gini coefficient ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (perfect inequality), so a value of 0.39 suggests a fairly uneven distribution of income globally during that year.
